title: Image archive file-format counts
method: ZIP inventory grouped by file suffix
limitations: File suffix is a storage format cue, not a scientific measurement.

title: Image-index to archive matching coverage
method: Metadata-to-file matching using documented filename rules
limitations: File matching does not prove physical-sample identity.

title: Readable image pixel dimensions
method: Pillow image metadata extraction
limitations: Pixel dimensions describe digital files, not physical print dimensions unless calibration metadata is available.

title: Image metadata missingness map
method: Binary missingness display across selected metadata fields
limitations: Missingness records source availability only; missing values are not imputed.

title: Ink-type Metadata Distribution
method: Value counts for image_index.ink_type_ph
limitations: Metadata categories describe source labels; they are not automatically standardised experimental variables.

title: Printed-shape Metadata Distribution
method: Value counts for image_index.shape
limitations: Metadata categories describe source labels; they are not automatically standardised experimental variables.

title: Irradiation-intensity Metadata Distribution
method: Value counts for image_index.intensity
limitations: Metadata categories describe source labels; they are not automatically standardised experimental variables.

title: Image brightness and contrast screening
method: Thumbnail grayscale intensity summary
limitations: Brightness and contrast may reflect imaging conditions as well as printed material appearance.

title: Foreground-area fraction by recorded shape category
method: Border-background thresholding on thumbnail images
scientific_interpretation: Foreground-area fraction by recorded shape category
limitations: Foreground area is a computed descriptor and not a validated printability score.

title: Example source image grid
method: First readable images loaded from the ZIP archive and displayed as thumbnails
limitations: The grid supports visual audit only and is not a representative statistical sample unless sampling is defined.

title: Source versus processed image comparison
method: Thumbnail display, grayscale conversion, and border-background foreground mask
limitations: Preprocessing can change interpretation; the mask is a review tool, not a ground-truth segmentation.

title: Example Image Grid by Recorded Ink Type
method: Deterministic first-3 sampling from the most frequent linked readable ink_type_ph groups
scientific_interpretation: Example Image Grid by Recorded Ink Type
limitations: Thumbnails are examples for audit only; group appearance may be affected by lighting, cropping, scale and source-image selection.

title: Example Image Grid by Recorded Shape
method: Deterministic first-3 sampling from the most frequent linked readable shape groups
scientific_interpretation: Example Image Grid by Recorded Shape
limitations: Thumbnails are examples for audit only; group appearance may be affected by lighting, cropping, scale and source-image selection.

title: Example Image Grid by Recorded Irradiation Intensity
method: Deterministic first-3 sampling from the most frequent linked readable intensity groups
scientific_interpretation: Example Image Grid by Recorded Irradiation Intensity
limitations: Thumbnails are examples for audit only; group appearance may be affected by lighting, cropping, scale and source-image selection.

title: Image Feature Heatmap by Recorded Ink Type
records_analysed: 308 linked readable images across 6 ink_type_ph groups
method: Median image descriptors by metadata group, min-max scaled per descriptor for visual comparison
scientific_interpretation: Image Feature Heatmap by Recorded Ink Type
limitations: Scaled heatmap shows descriptor patterns only; it does not establish causality, printability or biological performance.

title: Image Feature Heatmap by Recorded Shape
records_analysed: 1031 linked readable images across 4 shape groups
method: Median image descriptors by metadata group, min-max scaled per descriptor for visual comparison
scientific_interpretation: Image Feature Heatmap by Recorded Shape
limitations: Scaled heatmap shows descriptor patterns only; it does not establish causality, printability or biological performance.

title: Image Feature Heatmap by Recorded Irradiation Intensity
records_analysed: 1027 linked readable images across 6 intensity groups
method: Median image descriptors by metadata group, min-max scaled per descriptor for visual comparison
scientific_interpretation: Image Feature Heatmap by Recorded Irradiation Intensity
limitations: Scaled heatmap shows descriptor patterns only; it does not establish causality, printability or biological performance.

title: Image Review Panel for Rows with Missing Metadata
records_analysed: 18 linked readable images with missing metadata
method: Rows ranked by count of missing selected metadata fields
scientific_interpretation: Image Review Panel for Rows with Missing Metadata
limitations: Missing metadata is source evidence, not a reason to invent labels or drop records automatically.

title: Duplicate and Near-duplicate Image Review Panel
method: Exact SHA-256 and thumbnail-hash duplicate cues displayed as thumbnails
scientific_interpretation: Duplicate and Near-duplicate Image Review Panel
limitations: Duplicate cues require human review; visual hash matches may be repeated images, similar images or hash collisions.

title: Unusual-image Review Panel
records_analysed: 18 linked readable images with screening flags or robust feature outliers
method: Review panel ranked by simple flags and robust outlier scores from thumbnail descriptors
limitations: Unusual-image flags are screening cues only; they may reflect imaging conditions rather than hydrogel behaviour.
